row.body: The map is folded toward its road line; the keyring lies beyond the fold, its tag turned face down. A short length of thread joins them but does not reach the road.
row.title: The key points past the marked road

sidecar.gloss: A key and route remain connected only by a short thread.
sidecar.rival_reading: A delayed farm delivery could leave a key and map where someone stopped; the route alone does not show a failed evacuation.
